title: feat(frontend): implement restrained municipal UI system, Leaflet GIS map, citizen portal, and admin consoles
author: SmartCity360 Architecture Team
problem: Generic AI-dashboard aesthetics (neon glowing gradients, giant empty heroes) fail municipal usability, accessibility, and credibility standards.
solution: Engineered a serious, accessible government portal utilizing Tailwind CSS tokens, Leaflet OpenStreetMap interactive GIS engine, multi-role workspaces (Citizen, Field Staff, City Administrator, Emergency Operator), data tables, and an interactive coordinate pin picker.
tests: npm.cmd run build (Typecheck and bundle validation)
python scripts/frontend_audit.py (Component and feature coverage verification)
security_considerations: Sanitized map inputs, accessible contrast ratios (WCAG 2.1 AA), and zero third-party commercial API key exposure.
